name: presence-map
description: Maps every public place a company controls where buyers and AI tools read about it (GitHub, package and image registries, model hubs, docs, MCP and agent directories), sorts the places into one-time and recurring, audits the one-time places against the company's own sources, and drafts the fixes. Never publishes. Use when asked to audit a company's online presence, check what AI tools see about a company, or plan where a company should show up.
